text: Hi Dr. Okafor, this is a reminder from St. Mary's Clinic. Your appointment #MC-20871 is on 05/11/2026 at 8:15 AM, in Suite 4B at 1200 N. Main St. Please arrive 15 minutes early and bring your insurance ID ZX-9034-117 and a photo ID. Your copay is $35.00, and any outstanding balance of $2,418.75 is due by 12/01/2026. To reschedule, call 1-800-555-0147 or +44 20 7946 0958, or email front.desk_2@stmarys-clinic.org. Reply with code 7305 to confirm. If the temperature outside drops below -5°C, we may switch you to a telehealth visit at https://stmarys.example/join/8f3k. Fasting is required for 12 hours, so no food after 8:00 PM on 05/10/2026.
